title: Forgotten Sunnahs
subtitle: Prophetic Sunnahs that are easy to follow

items.title: Reciting Ayat Al-Kursi after every prayer
items.text: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise unless he dies.

items.title: Praying two rak'ahs after ablution
items.text: Whoever performs ablution and performs it well, then prays two rak’ahs, facing them with his heart and face, Paradise will be guaranteed for him.

items.title: Supplication after the call to prayer
items.text: Whoever says the well-known supplication after the call to prayer, the intercession of the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, will be permitted for him on the Day of Resurrection.

items.title: Early to Friday
items.text: Coming early to Friday prayer is one of the great Sunnahs and it brings a great reward.

items.title: Reading Surah Al-Kahf on Friday
items.text: Reciting Surat Al-Kahf on Friday is a light for the believer between the two Fridays.

items.title: Pray a lot for the Prophet on Friday
items.text: One of the best deeds on Friday and its night is to pray a lot and send peace and blessings upon the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him.

items.title: Peace when entering the house
items.text: If you enter your house and say hello, it will be a blessing for you and your family.

items.title: Remember God when entering the house
items.text: Remembering God when entering the house and eating is a reason to expel Satan from staying the night and eating.

items.title: The siwak
items.text: The siwak purifies the mouth, pleasing to the Lord, and is used during prayer, ablution, and reading the Qur’an.

items.title: Sleeping with ablution
items.text: It is Sunnah for a Muslim to sleep in a state of purity and remembrance of God Almighty.

items.title: Shake the bed before sleeping
items.text: If one of you goes to bed, let him shake it inside his garment, for he does not know what he left behind on it.

items.title: Sleeping on the right side
items.text: One of the guidance of the Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, was to sleep on the right side while reciting the remembrance of sleep.

items.title: Saying Bismillah before eating
items.text: If one of you eats, let him mention the name of God, and if he forgets, let him say: In the name of God, first and last.

items.title: Eating with the right hand
items.text: It is Sunnah to eat and drink with the right hand, and to eat from what follows a person.

items.title: Licking fingers after eating
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, commanded licking the fingers after eating before wiping them, as there is a blessing in food.

items.title: Praise after food
items.text: Whoever eats food and says, “Praise be to God who fed me this and provided me with it,” his previous sins will be forgiven.

items.title: The sneezer gloated
items.text: If a Muslim sneezes and praises God, he has the right for his brother to gloat at him by saying: May God have mercy on you.

items.title: Visit the patient
items.text: Visiting the sick is one of the rights of a Muslim over his brother, and it brings reward, supplication, and mercy.

items.title: Follow the funeral
items.text: Following the funeral, praying over it, and witnessing its burial are Sunnahs with great reward.

items.title: Praying for a Muslim in the back of the unseen
items.text: A Muslim’s prayer for his brother in the back of the unseen is answered, and the angel says: And you have the same.

items.title: Removing harm from the road
items.text: Removing harm from the road is charity and a branch of faith.

items.title: Joviality in the face of a Muslim
items.text: Do not despise any act of kindness, even if you meet your brother with a cheerful face.

items.title: Maintaining the two rak’ahs of Duha
items.text: The Duha prayer is a thanksgiving for the joints of the body, and the minimum is two rak’ahs.

items.title: Witr before bed for those who fear that they will not get up
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, recommended performing Witr before sleep for those who are not guaranteed to pray at the end of the night.

items.title: Fasting three days of every month
items.text: Fasting three days of every month is like fasting forever, and it is one of the prophetic commandments.

items.title: Breakfast is with dates or dates
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would break his fast with fresh fruits, and if he did not find them, then dates, and if he did not find them, he would eat water.

items.title: Prayers at breakfast
items.text: The fasting person has a supplication that will not be rejected when he breaks his fast, so he should be careful to pray for the good things of this world and the hereafter.

items.title: Asking forgiveness in the council
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, used to ask forgiveness and repent a lot in one sitting.

items.title: Council expiation
items.text: It is Sunnah to end the assembly with a supplication for the atonement of the assembly: Glory be to You, O God, and with Your praise...

items.title: Believing in good things
items.text: The Prophet, peace and blessings of God be upon him, loved the time when he was wearing his shoes, when he was on his feet, when he was ablutions, and in all his affairs.
